name: OmaRazer
author: asdfsnlr
description: An Omarchy shell bar widget and panel plugin that connects to the OpenRazer daemon to monitor and manage connected peripherals (keyboards, mice, mousemats, headsets, and accessories) with battery status, RGB lighting effects, brightness, polling rate, and mouse DPI preset/profile controls.

barWidget.description: Monitor and manage connected devices, battery levels, lighting effects, brightness, and polling rates.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: What to show next to the icon in the bar: connected device count, the first battery-powered device's charge level, or just the icon.
